window_as_printed: peak load frequency TBD (pulse-width chart not extractable)
allowance_as_printed: shall not exceed

note: DC2R-2 peak power envelope -> other.

limit: BBU shelf output ramps to full power within < 2 ms after busbar falls to 48.5 V for 2 ms; busbar never below 46 V during transition

limit: maximum active-power change rate must be limitable, selectable in a range agreed with Fingrid, indicatively 5 MW/min – 50 MW/min
allowance_as_printed: pätötehon suurinta muutosnopeutta tulee kyetä rajoittamaan
quote: Muutosnopeuden (MW/min) tulee olla valittavissa Fingridn kanssa määritettävällä vaihteluvälillä, jonka ohjeellinen suuruus on 5 MW/min – 50 MW/min.
note: Translation: the change rate (MW/min) must be selectable within a range set with Fingrid, indicatively 5-50 MW/min. Higher rates allowed for agreed demand-flexibility services, fast limiting (9.1.8/9.1.9) and recovery (9.1.11). Rate-unit rule (no interval) -> 1 min.

limit: largest single stepwise power change caused by the facility's internal process 50 MW (unless power-quality requirements set tighter limits)
allowance_as_printed: Suurin sallittu ... on 50 MW
quote: Suurin sallittu kulutuslaitoksen sisäisestä prosessista aiheutuva yksittäinen askelmainen tehonmuutos on 50 MW
note: Translation: the largest permitted single step power change caused by the facility's internal process is 50 MW.

limit: on Fingrid request: activate within 1 s of the control signal; reach the set power within a predefined time of at most 15 min; able to reduce by at least 30 % of pre-activation power; at least three preset levels
window_as_printed: response: activation within one second (setpoint within ≤ 15 minutes)
allowance_as_printed: tulee aktivoitua yhdessä sekunnissa
quote: Toiminnon tulee aktivoitua yhdessä sekunnissa ohjaussignaalin saapumisesta Fingridin järjestelmästä
note: Response-time rule: window = the activation response time (1 s); the setpoint-reaching time (≤15 min, 1-15 min class) noted as spread. Translation: the function must activate within one second of the control signal arriving.

limit: automatic reduction of at least 30 % of pre-activation power when voltage falls below a Fingrid-set limit, with Fingrid-set operating time
window_as_printed: operating time set by Fingrid in advance (no value printed)
allowance_as_printed: Pätötehoa tulee kyetä rajoittamaan vähintään 30 %
quote: Pätötehoa tulee kyetä rajoittamaan vähintään 30 % toiminnon käynnistymistä edeltävästä tehosta.
note: Translation: active power must be reducible by at least 30 % of the pre-activation power. No time printed.

limit: peak magnitude of continuous cyclic power variation ≤ 20 % of Pmax,d, at most 40 MW
basis: rated consumption Pmax,d (per consumption unit in phased projects)
allowance_as_printed: täytyy rajoittaa ... raja-arvojen sisälle; limits may be exceeded briefly only for transient grid voltage disturbances, each exceedance no longer than the window length
quote: Taulukko 9.1. Syklisten tehoheilahteluiden sallittu suuruus.
note: One row per printed table row (DC2R-1). limit: withstand 0.00 pu for 200 ms, 0.5 pu to 1.0 s, 0.85 pu to 10 s, 0.9 pu thereafter; 1.2 pu for 5 s; eight 100 ms three-phase faults within 90 s
basis: pu of pre-disturbance voltage at connection point
window_as_printed: 100 ms faults (shortest); 200 ms at 0 pu; 90 s multiple-fault period
allowance_as_printed: ei saa irrota
